description: Collects the profilestore runtime building blocks—Profile Store—and composes them for reuse in Roblox experiences.

ProfileStore.luau.description: Profile Store provides the module implementation used by the Profilestore package. Public entry points include `AcquireRunnerThreadAndCallEventHandler`, `RunEventHandlerInFreeThread`, `Connection.Disconnect`, `SignalClass.New`, `SignalClass.Connect`, `SignalClass.GetListenerCount`, `SignalClass.Fire`, `SignalClass.Wait`.
